title: Chromasync Config
description: Records where each installed target writes its generated artifacts. Auto-managed by `chromasync target install` at ~/.config/chromasync/config.toml. Read by the generate, wallpaper, and batch commands so an installed target writes to its recorded output_dir instead of the generic --output fallback.

targets.description: Installed target entries. Empty when no target has been installed yet.

target.description: One row under [[targets]] mapping an installed target to its output directory and overwrite flag.

name.description: Target name. Lowercase letters, digits, '-', or '_'. Matches the `name` field of the installed target TOML and must not collide with a built-in target name.

output_dir.description: Directory where this target's generated artifacts are written. A leading `~` or `~/` expands to the user's home directory at resolve time.

source.description: Location of the installed target file relative to the config root (e.g. "targets/gtk.toml").

overwrite.description: When true, generation overwrites existing artifacts for this target (a per-target --force). A global --force on the CLI overrides this regardless of the recorded value.
